stages.title: Draw the pumpkin outline
stages.instruction: Start with the outline. Type this program in the editor, then press Run.
stages.why: Our world runs from −200 to 200. A circle is drawn to Tracy’s left. Facing right at (0, −140) puts its center at (0, 0).
stages.snippet:

bgcolor("black")

penup()
setposition(0, -140)
setheading(0)
pendown()
color("darkorange")
circle(140)

stages.expected: One orange circle centered in the black world.
stages.predict: Why is the starting y value −140 instead of 0?
stages.answer: circle(140) starts on the edge, 140 pixels below the center. Starting at (0, 0) would put the center at (0, 140), partly outside the world.
stages.experiment: Change circle(140) to circle(100). Notice that its bottom stays in the same place.

stages.title: Fill the circle
stages.instruction: Put begin_fill() immediately before circle(140), and end_fill() immediately after it.
stages.why: color() sets the outline and fill color. begin_fill() records a shape; end_fill() fills that shape.

# The circle starts at its bottom edge.

setheading(0)
pendown()
color("darkorange")
begin_fill()
circle(140)
end_fill()
stages.predict: What happens if you leave out end_fill()?
stages.answer: The outline is drawn, but the fill is never completed.
stages.experiment: Try color("orange") or color("#f97316"). Keep the quotation marks.
